entities.summary: Simon Mepeham was a prominent religious figure in the Medieval era, recognized for shaping spiritual communities and religious practice in Meopham. Born in an unknown year, Mepeham's life spanned from 1275 to 1333-10-20. He played a key role in the transformation of religious practice during this period. Mepeham's legacy can be seen in the enduring influence of his teachings on the spiritual lives of his contemporaries. His impact on the development of religious thought in the region was significant, and his memory continues to be celebrated by historians and scholars today.
